name: AI Conviction Book
outlook: Opening the book. The dominant force is still the AI compute build-out, so the portfolio is overweight the picks-and-shovels of that cycle — NVIDIA as the toll road, the foundry/networking complex around it, and the mega-caps funding the capex — balanced by quality cash machines and a little consumer/financial ballast that holds up if growth wobbles. A measured crypto sleeve rides the macro-liquidity tape (BTC is a HOLD per today's dossier, not a chase). ~13% is kept in cash as dry powder to add into drawdowns rather than buying everything at once.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.thesis: The toll road on AI compute and the single highest-conviction name in the book. Sits at the center of hyperscaler + sovereign capex; the plan is to own it as the core position and accumulate on drawdowns.

positions.name: TSMC
positions.thesis: The foundry chokepoint — every advanced AI chip is built here. First mover on Taiwan/China headlines, which is the main risk, but irreplaceable on a multi-year view.

positions.name: Broadcom
positions.thesis: Custom-ASIC and networking beneficiary as hyperscalers diversify away from merchant GPUs. Captures AI spend that doesn't flow to NVIDIA.

positions.name: AMD
positions.thesis: The credible #2 accelerator. Smaller, higher-variance position sized as the asymmetric bet if it takes meaningful inference share.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.thesis: Best-in-class quality compounder with Azure + OpenAI distribution of AI compute. Core mega-cap holding that holds up when growth names wobble.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.thesis: TPUs + Gemini + a search cash machine, and the cheapest of the mega-caps on the AI build-out. Owns its own silicon, which de-risks the NVIDIA dependency.

positions.name: Amazon
positions.thesis: AWS re-acceleration plus in-house Trainium silicon, with retail-margin recovery as free optionality.

positions.name: Meta Platforms
positions.thesis: AI-driven ad efficiency is funding the capex out of a high-free-cash-flow core. Self-financing AI bet rather than a cash-burning one.

positions.name: Apple
positions.thesis: Defensive mega-cap that holds in a risk-off tape, with on-device AI as longer-dated optionality. Lowers the beta of the book.

positions.name: Tesla
positions.thesis: High-beta sentiment proxy that often moves with crypto. Kept small for upside torque and explicitly sized for the volatility.

positions.name: JPMorgan Chase
positions.thesis: Bellwether for credit and the rate cycle; diversifies away from pure tech beta and benefits if the soft-landing read holds.

positions.name: Walmart
positions.thesis: The cleanest read on the US consumer and ballast that holds up in a slowdown. Defensive anchor for the book.

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.thesis: Core crypto sleeve driven by macro liquidity and ETF/treasury demand. Today's dossier reads HOLD, so this is a position to ride — not chase — sized to tolerate the volatility.

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.thesis: Higher-beta crypto satellite to the BTC core. Smaller weight reflecting the lower conviction relative to Bitcoin.
